items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I made friends with Panassié, Charles Delaunay, Curt Moore , Jack Dimitri.

ctx.x: sign it. But I don't exactly remember how I...whether I used to swipe them from the lawyer...but anyway, I'd get the kid's name, you understand, and then I'd put it on that thing and then take it to a judge...this one judge who knew when I first used to take them for a lawyer . Then I'd take them to this judge and he'd always sign it. And I got a lot of black kids out of jail that way. And they never did catch on to it. I guess if they'd caught on to it I'd have really went to Gatesville. I was about 15. That was…

You know, speaking of going to Europe and of my trip to Europe that time, when I accidentally went over in 1948 instead of Willie, I made a lot of friends. I made friends with Panassié, Charles Delaunay, Curt Moore , Jack Dimitri. I met was not on the scene, this guy who...Jack Morgantini. Those days Monestier / the one who had the Hot Clubs promoting concerts and you had to make contacts with him.

But later on, as the years went by, I made contact...somebody wrote me a letter, said that this guy Jean Maurice Monestier was trying to reach me because Louis Jordan had signed for some dates and that he had not come to fulfill these engagements. And this had caused, you know, quite a problem...the promoters lost a lot of money. So they wanted somebody to come...and this was in '69 when I first started doing these things for Monestier.
